# MENASCO

> Founded in the UAE in 1994, MENASCO delivers integrated mechanical, electrical, plumbing and fire protection systems for complex projects in seven countries.

Established in 1994 in the UAE as MENASCO Mechanical Contracting L.L.C.

---

## About MENASCO

Founded in the UAE in 1994, MENASCO is an MEP contractor delivering mechanical, electrical, plumbing and fire protection systems for high-rise, hospitality, infrastructure and mission-critical projects, with offices in seven countries.

- [About MENASCO](https://menascogroup.com/about/llms.txt): Company overview, approach, vision, mission and values.

---

## Key Facts

- Established in 1994 in the UAE as MENASCO Mechanical Contracting L.L.C.
- Operates as an integrated MEP (mechanical, electrical, plumbing and fire protection) engineering and contracting company.
- 350+ Projects Successfully Delivered
- 32+ Years of Engineering Excellence
- 7 Countries of Operation (United Arab Emirates, Saudi Arabia, Egypt, United Kingdom, United States, Jordan, Syria)
- Dubai, UAE is MENASCO’s Head Office.
- Regional offices in Riyadh (MENASCO KSA), Cairo (MENASCO Misr), London (United Kingdom), Denver (United States), Amman (Jordan), Damascus (Syria).
- Serves sectors including Residential / Commercial, Hospitality & Landmark Entertainment, Advanced Technical Facilities, Infrastructure & Utilities.
- Core service lines include MEP, Civil, Manufacturing & Prefabrication, EPC, Data Centers, alongside dedicated data center MEP delivery.
- Delivers specialist engineering for data centers, mission-critical, healthcare, energy, and other technically demanding facilities.
- Project-delivery approach incorporates early project engagement, BIM-driven coordination, and disciplined execution.
- Maintains a dedicated Innovation & Technology ecosystem spanning Automatic Tendering Logic Assessment System (ATLAS), LYNX, AI Engineering, MENASCO Connect.
- Maintains an integrated QHSE system certified to ISO 9001:2015, ISO 14001:2015, ISO 45001:2018.

---

## Services

MENASCO services: MEP engineering and installation, EPC turnkey delivery, data centers, civil works and BIM, and off-site manufacturing and prefabrication.

### MEP

- [MEP Services: Mechanical, Electrical & Plumbing](https://menascogroup.com/services/mep/llms.txt): Mechanical, electrical, plumbing and fire protection by MENASCO: BIM-coordinated installation, testing and commissioning, with 350+ MEP projects delivered.

Covers: Mechanical Systems, Electrical & ELV Systems, Plumbing, Water & Drainage Systems, Fire Protection & Life Safety Systems.

### Civil

- [Civil & Structural Works, Integrated with MEP](https://menascogroup.com/services/civil/llms.txt): MENASCO coordinates civil and structural works with its MEP delivery, working with established specialist civil partners: foundations, underground utilities and equipment infrastructure under one construction programme.

Covers: BIM & Digital Engineering.

### Manufacturing & Prefabrication

- [Manufacturing & Prefabrication](https://menascogroup.com/services/manufacturing-prefabrication/llms.txt): In-house MEP manufacturing and prefabrication in the UAE, Saudi Arabia and Egypt: data center white spaces, E-Houses, switchgear, ductwork and modular assemblies, tested before dispatch.

Covers: Modular, Custom.

### EPC

- [EPC — Engineering, Procurement & Construction](https://menascogroup.com/services/turnkey-developments/llms.txt): MENASCO delivers EPC for complex infrastructure: multidisciplinary engineering, global equipment procurement, civil and MEP construction and in-house manufacturing under one accountable contract.

### Data Centers

- [Data Centers](https://menascogroup.com/services/data-centers/llms.txt): Data center MEP by MENASCO: Tier III and Tier IV topologies, CRAC and CRAH cooling, UPS and generator resilience, for greenfield and brownfield sites.

---

## Projects & Sectors

MENASCO delivers projects across all 7 of its countries of operation: United Arab Emirates, Saudi Arabia, Egypt, United Kingdom, United States, Jordan, Syria. The website features a selection of 138 of these projects, organized into 4 sectors.

- Residential / Commercial: Integrated engineering solutions for residential, commercial, office, and mixed-use developments.
- Hospitality & Landmark Entertainment: High-performance MEP delivery for premium hospitality, resort, cultural landmark, and entertainment destination environments.
- Advanced Technical Facilities: Specialist engineering for data centers, mission-critical, healthcare, energy, and technically demanding facilities.
- Infrastructure & Utilities: Category reserved for future projects — detailed scope has not yet been published.

- [All Projects & Sectors](https://menascogroup.com/projects/categories/llms.txt): Full project portfolio, browsable by sector.

The department provides maternity, antenatal and women's health services for the city and the surrounding east-coast communities. The wider hospital is internationally accredited and also offers emergency, cardiology, paediatric, surgical & diagnostic care.
- [NMC Hospital Fujairah](https://menascogroup.com/projects/nmc-hospital-fujairah/llms.txt): NMC Hospital Fujairah is a private multi-speciality hospital serving Fujairah city and the surrounding east coast of the United Arab Emirates. Operating under the NMC Healthcare brand, one of the country's largest private healthcare networks, it offers outpatient clinics, inpatient wards, diagnostic imaging, laboratory services and emergency care. It complements the emirate's government hospitals and draws patients from across the Eastern Region. This staff accommodation building in Fujairah houses medical and support personnel working at a private hospital in the city. Purpose-built residential blocks of this kind are common across the United Arab Emirates healthcare sector, providing single and shared rooms together with communal dining, laundry and recreation space. Siting the building close to the hospital keeps staff within a short commute of shift work.

- [IRIS Data Center](https://menascogroup.com/projects/iris-data-center/llms.txt): A prefabricated modular data centre campus in Abu Dhabi, assembled from 552 factory-built units arranged across four separate data centre buildings. The campus carries around 18MW of IT capacity and is designed to Uptime Institute Tier III standards for concurrent maintainability. It is configured for mission-critical workloads that need resilient, high-availability capacity. A hyperscale campus, this building was stripped back and rebuilt to current design standards, restoring its white space, power and cooling infrastructure. Modular construction of this kind allows each building on such a campus to be delivered, replaced or returned to service quickly, supporting cloud, enterprise and high-density workloads for the regional market. The battery rooms at the IRIS Data Center campus in Abu Dhabi house the stored-energy plant that holds the site's critical load during a mains interruption, bridging the gap until standby generation picks up. They sit within a prefabricated modular data centre development whose halls are assembled from factory-built units. Dedicated, environmentally controlled battery accommodation of this kind is a standard requirement for facilities targeting Uptime Institute Tier III resilience. This campus is a prefabricated modular development in which the halls are assembled from factory-built units and joined by common site services. The external areas carry the access routes, utility corridors and hardstanding that let the buildings run as a single high-availability facility.
- [Gas Bottling Plant](https://menascogroup.com/projects/gas-bottling-plant/llms.txt): This industrial facility in the United Arab Emirates is a gas bottling and distribution plant, where bulk liquefied petroleum gas is received, stored and decanted into cylinders for onward supply. Plants of this kind bring together a filling hall and cylinder carousel, bulk storage vessels, a cylinder yard and loading bays for distribution vehicles. Dedicated fire protection, gas detection and safety systems govern the layout throughout.
- [Sheikh Zayed Armour School](https://menascogroup.com/projects/sheikh-zayed-armour-school/llms.txt): The Armour School is a military training establishment inside a UAE Armed Forces cantonment, providing instruction for armoured corps personnel. The school forms one element of a wider garrison complex rather than standing as an isolated building.

The plant treats wastewater from Sharjah's residential and commercial districts, with treated effluent used for irrigation and other non-potable purposes. The phase-6 works extended treatment capacity at the existing site.

Plot 4E is one of the individually numbered development parcels within that grid.
- [DMCC Uptown Place Twin Towers](https://menascogroup.com/projects/dmcc-uptown-place-twin-towers/llms.txt): One Uptown Place and Two Uptown Place are twin commercial towers of 21 and 15 storeys in the Uptown Dubai district, next to Jumeirah Lakes Towers. Together they add more than 560,000 sq ft of Grade A office space and 82,000 sq ft of retail, with floor plates ranging from 2,100 to 17,600 sq ft. Amenities include in-building dining, a swimming pool and more than 1,600 parking spaces, and both towers target LEED Gold certification.
- [Alba Residences](https://menascogroup.com/projects/alba-residences/llms.txt): The Alba Residences is an ultra-luxury beachfront development on the Crescent of Palm Jumeirah in Dubai, comprising three low-rise buildings of nine and ten storeys set within roughly 26,000 square metres of landscaped grounds. It offers 88 simplex and duplex homes together with penthouses, and day-to-day services are managed by the Dorchester Collection. Amenities include a private beach, a wellness centre of about 3,000 square metres and beachfront dining. Completion is expected in 2028.
- [Coastline Substation](https://menascogroup.com/projects/coastline-substation/llms.txt): Coastline is a 132/11 kV primary substation on Dubai's high-voltage transmission network. It takes in power at 132 kV and steps it down to 11 kV for distribution to the homes, hotels, shops and public facilities in the district around it. Like other primary substations in the city, it is built as an enclosed, indoor station, allowing it to sit close to occupied buildings without an open switchyard.
- [Franck Muller Yachting](https://menascogroup.com/projects/franck-muller-yachting/llms.txt): Franck Muller Yachting is a 36-storey branded residential tower in Dubai Maritime City, a waterfront district between Port Rashid and the Dubai Dry Docks. Themed around the Swiss watchmaker's design language, it holds about 574 fully furnished studios and one- and two-bedroom apartments, along with a small number of duplexes and penthouses. Residents' facilities include rooftop pools, a padel court, an outdoor cinema and landscaped gardens. Handover is scheduled for 2028.
- [King's College Hospital Dubai](https://menascogroup.com/projects/king-s-college-hospital-dubai/llms.txt): King's College Hospital London - Dubai is a JCI-accredited British multi-specialty hospital in Dubai Hills, off Al Khail Road, currently operating around 100 inpatient beds. A major expansion under way will roughly double bed capacity to about 200 and add operating theatres, together with dedicated centres for oncology, complex liver disease, critical care and precision medicine. The hospital remains fully open to patients throughout the works, which are due to complete in 2028.

## Innovation & Technology

- Automatic Tendering Logic Assessment System (ATLAS): ATLAS is a MENASCO pilot project focussed on AI-powered compliance.
- LYNX: LYNX is MENASCO's intelligent field quality management platform, built to make identifying, assigning, and resolving construction issues faster and more transparent.
- AI Engineering: Using AI across engineering, quantity takeoffs, recruitment, payroll management and tenders, MENASCO has increased its workforce efficiency by 30%.
- MENASCO Connect: MENASCO Connect is our proprietary workforce management platform, integrating recruitment, manpower planning, site attendance, leave management, employee assessments, and internal communications into a unified digital environment.

## Quality, Health, Safety & Environment

Quality, health, safety, and environmental responsibility are embedded in every stage of project delivery, guided by international standards and a commitment to continuous improvement. An integrated QHSE management system, certified to ISO 9001:2015, ISO 14001:2015, and ISO 45001:2018, supports consistent practices, proactive risk management, and accountability across operations.
